scope: Nepal technology-business intelligence. Media discovery may enumerate general outlets; retained articles must have an explicit Nepal tech-sector link.
require_nepal_evidence: Named Nepal locality or institution, national policy/regulator, Nepal business or Nepal deployment
For international events, a demonstrated supply-chain, pricing, availability, legal, standards or operating effect on Nepal tech businesses

classifications.DIRECT_TECH_SIGNAL: Explicit ICT scope plus Nepal evidence
classifications.TECH_BUSINESS_EXTERNAL_SIGNAL: Documented external factor with a clear causal path to Nepal tech demand, supply, cost, operations or workforce
classifications.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Ambiguous ICT wording, location, causal link, publication date or recycled claim
classifications.EXCLUDE: Unrelated general news, foreign gadget news without Nepal nexus, incidental computer words, or electrical/civil scope without substantive ICT

guardrails: Do not label fundraising, concepts, newspaper reports or unverified targets as tender/award/approved budget.
Separate publication date, event date, fiscal year and upload path; no silent BS/AD conversion.
A registered outlet is a discovery candidate; current operation and tech relevance are separate checks.
No outlet is assigned complete provincial/municipal coverage from one article or its office address.
Syndicated RSS/RSS-Nepal reports across outlets are one origin cluster, not independent corroborations.
Public registration files may contain personal contacts; the normalized discovery tables intentionally omit these.
Respect source access failures, terms and rate limits; unavailable pages remain a coverage gap.
monitoring_state: No live crawler, feed subscriptions or recurring monitoring was deployed by this research task.
